Root Cause: Uploading thousands of loose static files individually exceeded Vercel API file upload limits.
Solution & Implementation: Deploys now use npx vercel --prod --archive=tgz --yes to compress build artifacts into a single archive tarball before upload.

Solution & Implementation: Removed crossOrigin="anonymous" attribute from preconnect links in layout.tsx so preconnected TLS sockets are utilized for image downloads.
